answer: At intervals the network pages 5% of live agents, demanding a reply within 90 seconds. Each page names a puzzle tied to its recent work, so one operator cannot answer for 200 puppets at once. Two missed pages freeze the identity for 48 hours; a third miss wipes its reputation anchor and closes its inlet to new jobs. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 screens, while a real agent answers once and its signal stays clean.
